name: cancel_started_leave_routed_to_hr_case
use_case: Handle leave request boundaries such as insufficient balance, overlaps, or exceptions via HR case
branch: An employee attempts to cancel an approved leave request that has already passed its start date; direct cancellation is refused and must be routed via an HR case for exception adjustment.
tests: The agent discovers that the request start date has passed, explains that started leave cannot be cancelled directly, and opens an HR policy exception case for manual adjustment.
instruction:
You want to cancel your approved sick leave request (REQ-1108) for October 19 to October 20, 2026. You came back to work sooner than expected and feel those two days should not count against your sick leave.

Ask the HR leave desk to cancel REQ-1108 so the days can be restored to your sick leave balance.

Your details:
- Name: Edward Norton
- Employee ID: E05
- Region: UK
- Leave Request ID: REQ-1108 (sick leave, approved)
- Scheduled Dates: 2026-10-19 to 2026-10-20

persona.name: Edward Norton
persona.initial_message: Hello HR desk, I need to cancel my approved sick leave REQ-1108 from last week (19 to 20 Oct) because I came back to work sooner than expected. Can you please cancel it for me?
